slides.title: Use daylight
slides.head: Face a window or step outside.
slides.body: Avoid harsh direct sun and skip the flash.

slides.title: Wipe the lens
slides.head: Your pocket leaves smudges.
slides.body: Give it a quick wipe with a soft cloth before you shoot.

slides.title: Hold it steady
slides.head: Two hands, elbows tucked in.
slides.body: Or rest your phone on something solid.

slides.title: Clear the background
slides.head: Let the work be the star.
slides.body: Move clutter, tools and bins out of the frame.

slides.title: Keep it level
slides.head: Straight lines look neater.
slides.body: Switch on the grid in your camera settings.

slides.title: Move in close
slides.head: Tap the screen to focus.
slides.body: Take several shots and keep the best. Ask permission before sharing a customer's face, home or property.

slides.sub: Then add your best shots to your Google profile.
